column3:
Competitor changes –
new entrants with green
credentials, entering market
without incurring transition
costs

Insurance policies becoming
unattractive due to pricing

Poor performance of climate
vulnerable assets

Risk perception increase
among co-financiers and
investors due to climate risk
uncertainty

Changing customer,
community and other
stakeholder views, attitudes,
perceptions and values on
climate.

Increased scrutiny including
from regulators, media,
on carbon emissions for a
business, its supply chain
including who provides
financing.

Increased stakeholder scrutiny
if lack of action on reduction
in emissions, or substantial
contribution to improving
resilience/ adaptive capacity
of local communities

Increased frequency and –
severity of climate-driven
events.
Flooding
Drought
Heatwave
Landslide
Wildfires

Stability of local ecosystems,
affecting food production/
and living environment

Rising temperatures affect
local infrastructure, working &
living conditions

Rising sea level affect local
ecosystems, increase flood
risk

Changing precipitation
patterns
Water stress
Deforestation
Soil degradation
